title: Fixed Wave Grooved Barrel and Guided Follower Display
description: One wholly newly authored fixed barrel-groove follower teaching display: a continuous thick upright drum has an actual closed undulating circumferential recessed groove, not an overlaid line. Its central shaft is carried by a grounded lower pedestal and complete rear-post upper cantilever. A separate front slider has a genuine square through-bore surrounding a grounded vertical guide; its complete radial pin enters the real drum groove at one fixed pose. Common full bed and upper guide bridge make one whole supported apparatus. This cylindrical sidewall-track and separate axial guided-follower relationship is different from flat face cams under directly guided stamp stems or a cam below a pivoted long helve. No old meshes or copied machine bodies. Three opaque constant PBR roles, metres Z up, one model zero scenes. Static artistic pose only: no exact engineering cam law, rotation, stroke, sliding fit, contact force, lubrication, transmission, manufacturing or machinery safety claim. Rigging animation interaction are not made.
